# Jordan Ellis: reaction to the call tracker and text-back (14 Oct 2026)

[[sources/historical_calls/2026-10-14-jordan-ellis-intro-call-4bbd735b/INDEX|Source index]] · [[sources/intake/records/4bbd735bd750c2a6cee5b5669f8a0ceb8a5b2e2dd9eb077a71ba698b55911111|Original]] · Lines L18-L22
Attributed historical evidence, not canonical TTROS truth.

## Summary
Liam described the call tracker and its one-minute text-back. Jordan liked the text-back and worried that it might sound robotic. Liam answered that Jordan writes the message himself.

## Points
- **Liam Duff:** the tracker sits in front of the existing number and logs every missed call (L18).
- **Liam Duff:** it texts the caller back within a minute (L19).
- **Jordan Ellis:** likes the text-back; says local customers text more than they call (L20).
- **Jordan Ellis:** worried it will sound like a robot because customers know the business (L21).
- **Liam Duff:** the business writes its own message (L22).

## Commitments and open loops
- None stated.

## Key quotes
> "My worry is it sounding like a robot." (Jordan Ellis, L21)

## Caveats
Jordan's view of how his customers behave is his own impression.
